data.long_meaning: The name Bahi is derived from the Arabic word bahh, meaning 'brightness' or 'brilliance'. It is often used to describe the morning light or the radiance of a bright, clear day. The name Bahi carries the meaning “Morning light, brilliance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Bahi usually hope their child will grow to embody morning light, brilliance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
